headlines.title: Coca-Cola vs. PepsiCo: Which Dividend King Deserves a Premium Valuation Right Now?
headlines.summary: PepsiCo pays the bigger dividend yield, but Coca-Cola has earned its premium price tag.

headlines.title: Is PepsiCo's Dividend in Danger of Being Cut?
headlines.summary: The beverage and snack company recently cut its guidance, and its shares have been nosediving this year.

headlines.title: PepsiCo Trades Near 52-Week Low: Should You Buy Now or Wait?
headlines.summary: PEP trades near its 52-week low as North American weakness, margin pressures and reduced earnings expectations raise questions about its recovery prospects.

headlines.title: PepsiCo Stock Has Fallen Out of Favor. That Could Create an Opportunity
headlines.summary: PepsiCo sits near a 52-week low after a brutal guidance cut, yet its international business keeps firing on all cylinders while the stock trades at a steep discount to its closest rivals. The question is whether Wall Street has already priced in the pain or is just getting started.

headlines.title: Coca-Cola vs. PepsiCo: Which Consumer Goods Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
headlines.summary: Coca-Cola boasts a 27% net margin but trades at a steep premium, while PepsiCo's diversified snacks portfolio commands a fraction of the valuation.

description: PepsiCo, Inc. engages in the manufacture, marketing, distribution, and sale of various beverages and convenient foods worldwide. The company operates through six segments: PepsiCo Foods North America; PepsiCo Beverages North America; International Beverages Franchise; Europe, Middle East and Africa; Latin America Foods; and Asia Pacific Foods. It offers cereals, chips, dips, granola bars, oatmeal, pasta, rice, and syrups and mixes; refrigerated dips and spreads; beverage concentrates, fountain syrups, and finished goods; and ready-to-drink tea and coffee products. The company also provides SodaStream sparkling water makers and related products, as well as various dairy products under the Agusha, Chudo, and Domik v Derevne brands. It serves wholesale and other distributors, foodservice customers, grocery stores, drug stores, convenience stores, discount/dollar stores, mass merchandisers, membership stores, hard discounters, e-commerce retailers and authorized independent bottlers, and others through a network of direct-store-delivery, customer warehouse, and distributor networks, as well as directly to consumers through e-commerce platforms and retailers. PepsiCo, Inc. was founded in 1898 and is based in Purchase, New York.
